CustomField.formula: IF(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Enabled") && Worldflow_Email_Access__c && Number_of_Active_Prefs__c > 0 && DATEVALUE(Worldflow_Last_Email_Sent__c) > Today() - 30 && NOT(Worldflow_Hard_Bounce__c) , "Is Receiving Research", IF(DATEVALUE(Worldflow_Last_Email_Sent__c) < Today() - 30,"No Longer Receiving Research", "Not Receiving Research"))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: This field can take up to 24 hours to display the user's actual research status.
CustomField.label: Research Status
